protected: All tests, manifests, lockfiles, generated output, migration and authority records; exact FK patch excluded
probe: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.98.1 cargo test --locked --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -p console-app --lib security_diagnostic_sink_tests
invariant: Retain stable logical production events without private DbError/RequestContextError Debug/Display
guide: Trace actual shared callers; repair existing owner without introducing new contracts; preserve test bytes; require same-probe GREEN plus nearest regressions and independent peer review
pre_mortem: A sibling path still violates invariant or positive control is suppressed; test pair and shared-caller review must detect both
detection: Classified real RED, exact GREEN counts, frozen test byte comparison, independent review
rollback: Scoped source revert; no data effects
remaining_holds: All dependent owners and full slice acceptance
